digest.component_or_area: capability registry and optional dependency management
propositions: A semantic capability registry must validate that every capability references a declared packaging extra and that no probe module is imported during registry construction or route discovery.
Semantic capabilities with error posture must emit actionable errors only at selected execution boundaries after mode/backend selection, not during route discovery or help generation.
Stable verbs and top-level help must remain accessible in a no-extras wheel without triggering errors for uninstalled optional dependencies.
Lean diagnostic, read-only, and dry-run modes must execute without requiring sibling live capabilities (e.g., audit show without audit serve, non-agent workflows without agent runtime).

Domain components for unavailable, abstain, and fallback capabilities retain control of result payloads, exceptions, and exit contracts; the registry provides metadata only and never manufactures domain results.
